title: Task
description: A unit of work within a security engagement, assigned to or claimed by an agent.

id.description: Unique identifier for the task (e.g. T-001).

parent_task.description: ID of the parent task, or null if this is a root task.

owner.description: Agent currently owning or working on this task.

target.description: Target asset, component, or scope this task operates on.

hypothesis.description: Hypothesis ID this task is investigating, or null if none.

dependencies.description: IDs of tasks that must complete before this task can start.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was last updated.

estimated_cost.description: Estimated cost of executing the task (in agent-credits or time units).

actual_cost.description: Actual cost incurred executing the task.
